data.exact_reserve_text: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end. The release in 2017 amounted to $90.9m (2016: $85.8m) driven by positive movements across a number of classes.

named_events.loss_description: Series of natural catastrophes impacting the US, Caribbean and Mexico in the second half of 2017; increased severity of large losses arising from these hurricanes and drove higher current year claims.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net release of prior year reserves. On a gross basis, analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year release of approximately 23.2 (USD millions), driven by favourable claims development across multiple classes (net release reported as $90.9m). This release was concentrated across marine, property and specialty-related classes, although 2017 itself was materially impacted by natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria) which increased current year claims.
raw_causal_phrases: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end.
driven by positive movements across a number of classes.
A release was made from the prior year net provision for claims of $90.9m (2016: $85.8m) driven by positive movements across a number of classes.
data.data_quality_notes: The note labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' quotes a net prior-year release of $90.9m (net of reinsurance). The required prior-year movement (gross) was not provided as a single gross figure in that note, so the gross prior-year movement has been calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross ultimate estimates diagonal comparison) resulting in an estimated gross release of 23.2 (USD millions). Lob movements listed in note 6 are net amounts; those are used for lob_movements with reduced confidence. All monetary amounts are reported in the syndicate's reporting currency (USD).
